I have only this small quarter-acre plot to feed my family, so I must tend it carefully with what I already have. I will carry compost from our homestead to spread on the rows, but chemical fertilizer and sprays are too expensive and hard to find in Lindi. We will sow the local nuts we saved from last season and work the plot ourselves between caring for the children and household chores.
